Recent Projects

Our work

Every photograph on this page is a Manley Ohana job. None of it is stock, none of it is a supplier's catalogue shot, and the operator on the machine in most of them is the owner. Twelve years of Central Florida floors — checkerboard tile in an Orlando kitchen, wood-look porcelain down a Windermere hallway, glue-down broadloom out of an office corridor that never closed, and a Cocoa Beach slab ground clean with the Atlantic through the sliders. Removal is not a pretty trade to photograph, which is exactly why it is worth showing you.
